query: What AIS bias correction protocols (reception footprint Rc correction, de-duplication, static vs dynamic message handling, spoofing/outlier detection) and QC metrics must be applied before MGIS mapping?

response.query: What AIS bias correction protocols (reception footprint Rc correction, de-duplication, static vs dynamic message handling, spoofing/outlier detection) and QC metrics must be applied before MGIS mapping?
response.answer: AIS bias correction protocols include reception footprint correction, de-duplication, and static vs dynamic message handling. Spoofing/outlier detection and QC metrics like signal-to-noise ratio are essential before MGIS mapping.
